skill.name: broken-skill
skill.description: A minimal fixture skill for testing packaging failures caused by incomplete interface metadata.
skill.summary: Test packaging validation with a deliberately incomplete skill fixture.
skill.author: yaojingang

security_audit.summary: No static findings were reported, and no semantic security issues were found in SKILL.md or agents/interface.yaml. The files contain metadata for an incomplete packaging fixture, with no executable code, network calls, filesystem access, or secret access.

content.value_statement: Skill authors need examples that expose incomplete marketplace metadata. This fixture provides a minimal broken skill for testing package validation and adapter handling.
actual_capabilities: Provides a minimal SKILL.md file with name and description metadata.
Includes interface metadata for manual activation and OpenAI adapter targeting.
Models a packaging failure caused by missing default prompt content.
Supports validation tests for metadata adapters and degraded execution paths.
Shows a metadata-only fixture with no bundled scripts or executable source files.
limitations: It is a test fixture, not an end-user automation workflow.
It does not provide a usable default prompt or task instructions.
It does not include scripts, tools, or runtime integrations.
It should not be marketed as a production-ready assistant skill.

use_cases.title: Validate Packaging Errors
use_cases.description: Confirm that a packager reports missing prompt metadata instead of accepting incomplete skill definitions.

use_cases.title: Review Marketplace Metadata
use_cases.description: Use the fixture as a small reference when checking required skill fields and adapter metadata.

use_cases.title: Test Adapter Degradation
use_cases.description: Exercise metadata-only adapter behavior when a skill cannot provide a full prompt interface.

prompt_templates.title: Inspect This Fixture
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this skill fixture and summarize why it is considered broken. Focus on missing user-facing prompt content and packaging impact.

prompt_templates.title: Compare With a Valid Skill
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare this fixture with a valid skill definition. List the required fields that are present and the prompt behavior that is missing.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Packaging Test
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a packaging validation test that uses this fixture. Describe the expected failure and the message a developer should see.

prompt_templates.title: Define Adapter Rules
prompt_templates.prompt: Propose adapter validation rules for metadata-only skills. Include how Claude, Codex, and Claude Code should handle incomplete prompts.

output_examples.input: Explain why this fixture fails packaging validation.
output_examples.output: The skill defines basic metadata but does not provide usable default prompt content. A packager should reject it or mark it as incomplete.

output_examples.input: Summarize the security posture of this fixture.
output_examples.output: The fixture is metadata-only and contains no scripts, network behavior, file operations, or secret access. The primary issue is completeness, not security.

output_examples.input: Describe a useful test based on this skill.
output_examples.output: A validation test can confirm that adapter tooling reports missing prompt behavior while still reading display metadata correctly.

best_practices: Use this fixture only in validation or packaging test suites.
Pair it with a valid fixture to verify both success and failure paths.
Keep failure expectations explicit so test results remain easy to diagnose.
anti_patterns: Do not publish this fixture as a user-facing productivity skill.
Do not treat metadata-only adapter output as a complete skill experience.
Do not add executable behavior just to hide a missing prompt interface.

faq.question: What is this skill for?
faq.answer: It is a test fixture for packaging and adapter validation, especially missing prompt interface behavior.

faq.question: Can end users run useful tasks with it?
faq.answer: No. It does not include a usable default prompt or workflow instructions.

faq.question: Does it execute commands?
faq.answer: No executable code or command script was found in the scanned files.

faq.question: Why mention Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Marketplace users may validate how different AI tools handle incomplete skill metadata.

faq.question: Is the issue a security problem?
faq.answer: No evidence of a security issue was found. The main issue is incomplete skill functionality.

faq.question: How should authors fix a similar skill?
faq.answer: Add clear prompt instructions and complete required interface fields before packaging or publication.
